settings.title: Clean the area.
settings.body: Use a gentle cleanser. Pat dry — no rubbing.

settings.title: Apply a thin layer.
settings.body: Cover the treatment area evenly. A pea-sized amount per zone is usually enough.

settings.title: Leave it.
settings.body: Follow your practitioner's timing guidance for the procedure you've booked.

settings.title: Remove before your appointment.
settings.body: Wipe with a clean cloth or tissue at the practitioner's instruction.

settings.headline: A short routine ahead of your appointment.
settings.closer: Your practitioner is the best guide for application timing specific to your booking. The four steps above are the standard preparation routine — your specific appointment may vary.

settings.headline: Clinical is the everyday. Two more strengths sit above it.
settings.body: Clinical Strength is the Senseless cream most clients buy. Advanced sits one step above — higher concentration, formulated for longer sessions, sensitive treatment areas, or microneedling-tier procedures. Professional is the flagship, developed with practitioners and available without restriction. Most clients buy Clinical. Some buyers go straight to Advanced. Both are the right choice for the appointments they're built for.

settings.question: What's the difference between Clinical and Advanced Strength?
settings.answer: Clinical is the everyday formula — built for routine aesthetic appointments. Advanced is a higher concentration, formulated for longer or more sensitive sessions. Same system, different appointment context.

settings.question: Is Clinical Strength enough for lip fillers?
settings.answer: Yes. Lip filler appointments sit comfortably in Clinical territory. Advanced only if your lips are particularly sensitive or your session runs longer than a quick top-up.

settings.question: What about microneedling?
settings.answer: Microneedling typically calls for Advanced Strength — longer session, broader treatment area. Clinical may suit smaller microneedling zones, but Advanced is the everyday recommendation for full-face appointments.

settings.question: What's in it?
settings.answer: A UK-formulated cosmetic preparation. Full ingredients list available on the packaging and below.

settings.question: How long does it last?
settings.answer: Senseless is designed for use ahead of a specific appointment. Specific duration varies by client and by application protocol — your practitioner is the best guide.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
